baseline: first retained MRI; no future-diagnosis selection

models.M2: M0 + cortical gray matter volume + DKT62 area-weighted mean thickness
models.M4: M2 + 62 ROI mean thickness + 62 ROI thickness SD

method: logistic ridge, glmnet alpha=0, independent traditional/JSD block penalties; intercept unpenalized
selection: minimum inner pooled log loss; ties <=1e-10 relative choose JSD-off, stronger JSD penalty, stronger traditional penalty
standardization: training mean and population SD, independently inside each inner and outer training split; drop training-constant columns
point_estimate: average five held-out probabilities per patient, then calculate metrics on 352 unique patients
bootstrap_method: paired class-stratified patient bootstrap of fixed repeat-averaged OOF predictions; conditional percentile 95% CI, no refitting
uncertainty_limit: conditional OOF bootstrap does not include full model-training and fold-dependence uncertainty; repeat dispersion descriptive, not independent replication
